fgm_voxelprint_ceramic_ht.name: VoxelPrint Ceramic HT
fgm_voxelprint_ceramic_ht.note: FGM VoxelPrint - FGM's Phrozen values (Sonic 4K, 0.1 mm: 4.5 s, bottom 25 s), carried to each printer and layer height as Phrozen's own filled crown resins change and by the resin's own layer curve (Asiga Composer, B1-HT). Fast: the same exposure, faster lift and retract. STARTING VALUES: run an exposure test on each printer and set the exposure found.
